hypothesis: Late-informed traders carry a coin's 07:00-08:00 UTC move into its 21:00-22:00 UTC hour the same day.
framework: Hourly grid. At 21:00 UTC rank the names by their BTC-residual return over the 07:00-08:00 UTC bar of the same day (13 bars earlier); buy the top N and sell the bottom N, equal weight, and hold for one hour, flat the rest of the day. Signal hour and holding hour are fixed by the mechanism; only the breadth is swept.
notes: Worked hourly example: a time-of-day continuation, one entry a day at 21:00 UTC held one hour.
